added_failures_note: the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite/after_suite arm, so the base arm was measured independently at the reviewed base revision (631aeecdf, identical to 6b12d8ff across tests/ids) and the head arm is the reviewed run's own gate_tests_ids.log at f92e37f70; both EXIT=0 with zero failing ids, so the run added no failing test

findings.text: follow-on: dd_version_at_or_before duplicates the live-at-version comparison owned by imas_codex/tools/graph_search.py:254, and the two disagree on a path with no INTRODUCED_IN edge — the owner's int mode requires the edge (EXISTS { MATCH (n)-[:INTRODUCED_IN]->... }) while dd_path_live_at treats a missing introduction as present, so one rule now has two spellings that drift.

follow-on: _version_tuple raises ValueError on an empty string (reproduced against the committed source: dd_path_live_at("3.22.0","3.42.0","") -> ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: ''), while the predicate's own docstring contracts only None as the disabling value; imas_codex/ids/workers.py:1138 passes dd_version_str = state.dd_version or "" to validate_mappings, so the one value the guard does not cover is the one that call site would supply if state.dd_version were ever unset. It does not block because imas_codex/cli/map.py:241 guarantees a non-empty dd_version before state is built.

item_verdicts.diff: Read all three commits against the base: 01144e63b adds dd_version_at_or_before, dd_path_live_at, DDPathLifecycle, dd_path_stale_reason and dd_path_lifecycles in graph_ops.py plus the _stale_paths filter in candidates.py and the validation and hand-off guards; f92e37f70 folds the INTRODUCED_IN/DEPRECATED_IN columns into the structure read (mapping.py:1676) and member read (handoff.py:245) so no guard issues its own lifecycle query; 137979cd2 adds only the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when is that unit tests exclude tf/coil/conductor/current/data for DD 4.1.1 from candidates, refuse it in validation naming its deprecation version and write it unexpanded, with tf/coil/current/data as positive control, a live-graph confirmation, and a negative control that drops the deprecation clause; tests/ids/test_deprecated_dd_targets.py carries all of these — test_retired_path_is_excluded_from_candidates and test_live_path_passes_the_candidate_filter, test_retired_path_is_refused_in_validation_naming_its_deprecation_version and test_live_path_passes_validation, test_retired_path_is_written_unexpanded_in_the_export and test_live_path_is_expanded_in_the_export, and the graph-marked test_lifecycle_predicate_on_the_live_graph — and the gate the worker ran asserts that measure.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is the fix of plan section 25 — one DD lifecycle predicate applied at candidate retrieval, binding validation and the hand-off export so a path retired at or before the mapping's DD version is excluded, refused and written unexpanded; imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py:944 adds dd_path_live_at and candidates.py:187 (candidate retrieval) and candidates.py:634 (cluster siblings), mapping.py:1815 (validate_mappings) and handoff.py:283 (build_mapping_handoff) each call it through dd_path_lifecycles or dd_path_stale_reason, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read the manifest at the run directory; it states base 6b12d8ff and head 137979cd2, the three commits, the tests/ids gate result (594 passed, 5 skipped, 8 deselected, exit 0), the live-graph result and the negative control, and it honestly leaves baseline_suite and after_suite empty rather than inventing a base arm — which is what lets the added-failure count be derived only by an independent base measurement.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The reviewed node was fenced to imas_codex/ids/{graph_ops,candidates,mapping,handoff}.py, tests/ids/test_deprecated_dd_targets.py and the evidence fragment; git diff --stat 6b12d8ff..137979cd2 reports exactly those six files, 604 insertions and 10 deletions, with nothing outside them.

justifications.durability: The negative control at tests/ids/test_deprecated_dd_targets.py reddens four tests including test_retired_path_is_refused_in_validation_naming_its_deprecation_version when the deprecation clause is dropped, and each added assertion compares the code's output against an independent constant or a mocked lifecycle the test supplies rather than against a value it also feeds the code, so the assertions are real guards.
justifications.evidence: The gate measures the done_when and its result is recorded — tests/ids/test_deprecated_dd_targets.py passes 10 tests in the worker's gate_unit.log, the run's gate_tests_ids.log shows the tests/ids suite at revision f92e37f70 with 594 passed and exit 0, gate_live_graph.log records the live-graph test passing with 1 passed and EXIT=0, and negative_control.log records the 4 failing ids with EXIT=1 — though the run's manifest names no baseline arm, so the suite delta rests on the base arm I measured independently.
justifications.fit: The additions follow the module's docstring and dataclass idiom in imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py:925-1050, carry no plan or ticket identifier in any symbol, filename or comment, and the three commits use conventional subjects with mechanism bodies and no attribution line.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py:944 implements the predicate the plan names and the three call sites it names each route through it (candidates.py:187, mapping.py:1815, handoff.py:283), with both a live path and a retired path asserted at every stage, so the landed change does what the goal states.
justifications.reuse: imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py:932 re-implements the "path live at DD version" rule that imas_codex/tools/graph_search.py:254 (_dd_version_clause) already owns in both int-major and semver modes, and graph_ops.py:925 hand-rolls version parsing where the repository standard_names and dd_accessor modules use packaging.version.Version, without extending either owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 6b12d8ff..137979cd2 shows the three commits touch exactly the six declared write paths with one purpose each, and no generated or gitignored file is staged.
